messages:
Ava: Heads up  need a lightweight observability bundle for cloud marketplace listing + HW SI onboarding. Small, scrubbed, reproducible.
Dara: Key pieces: OTLP traces, GPU/cpu/mem metrics, concise dashboard queries, and a replay tool.
Noel: For hardware partners, include gpu.vendor, gpu.model, gpu.memory_gb and obfuscated serials. Add a `burst` flag for optional high-QPS sample.
Rafael: Semantic conventions: OTel >=1.15, resource.service.name, deployment.environment, service.instance.id. Also include `redwood.build` tag.
Eve (Datadog): From Datadog: add `dd.env`, `dd.service_version`, and a `dd.trace_url` template. We can pre-wire a dashboard preview if you include those.
Ava: Proposed manifest snippet: ```json
{
  "manifest_version":"1.0",
  "services":["inference-proxy","model-worker","cache"],
  "spans":3500,
  "metrics":1500,
  "logs":800,
  "masking":"user_id,session_id,serials"
}
```
Dara: Deliverables: samples (normal + burst), replay script (python ndjson -> OTLP), collector config (route to Datadog/local), dashboards/queries.md, smoke tests.
Noel: We'll ensure serials hashed as `HW-XXXX-<hash>` and no logos.
Rafael: Add smoke scripts in curl/node/py that call a local mock to generate telemetry end-to-end. Also document recommended collector limits (cpu 0.25, mem 256Mi).
Eve (Datadog): We'll prepare a dashboard template and small flamegraph PNG. Requesting `trace.sample_rate` attribute on spans for sampling demos.
OpsBot: automated: uploaded draft `marketplace-observability-sample-v1.tar.gz` to drive https://rwd.co/obs/marketplace-v1 (internal).
Ava: Action items: Ava -> manifest + README, Dara -> replay script + collector config, Noel -> sample bundles, Eve -> dashboard template. Target: 7 days.
Eve (Datadog): Reviewing PR when ready. Quick note: include example metric query `avg:gpu.utilization{service:inference-proxy}.rollup(avg,60)` and trace linking pattern.
Ava: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-obs-samples/pull/3 - includes manifest, samples, replay, and dashboards/queries.md.
Noel: Burst bundle uploaded as optional artifact.
Dara: Legal check tomorrow for public listing; marking bundle internal until sign-off.
Ava: Thanks all. Follow-ups: merge after legal, Eve to share dashboard, Noel to finalize obfuscation. Closing target next Friday. :thumbsup:
